subject: Renewal: term uplift + capacity increase — procurement portal & PO sequencing
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Wells <sarah.wells@heliohealth.com>, Helio Procurement <procure@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: term uplift + capacity increase — procurement portal & PO sequencing

Hi Sarah / Helio procurement team,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per Ben's ask, Helio is looking to move the upcoming renewal to a 36-month term and commit to a ~15% capacity uplift across usage tiers. Before I prepare the SOW addendum and pricing schedule, can you confirm a few procurement items so we can sequence PO issuance without back-and-forth delays?

Request list (to confirm):
- Procurement portal URL / vendor ID you want us to register under (we can push invoices directly to the portal if you provide the vendor token).
- Billing terms preference (Net-30 / Net-45 / Net-60) — Ben mentioned Net-45 during the call; please confirm.
- Required evidence: SOC 2 Type II report (extract acceptable), insurance certificate, and vendor attestation for data handling.
- Formal PO cadence: Do you need a single PO that covers the full 36 months or quarterly PO lanes?
- Contract signature preference: DocuSign link vs. portal-sign (we can do both).

I'll attach our evidence bundle and a short playbook for PO sequencing to speed legal and procurement review. If you can send the procurement questionnaire your team uses (or the portal registration form), I'll route to finance/legal for the billing and tax details (W-9, tax ID).

Goal: have SOW addendum ready and PO path agreed so we can lock pricing and start provisioning uplift capacity before the renewal effective date.

Thanks — I'll follow up internally as soon as I have the Helio portal details.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]

Attachments: redwood_evidence_packet_v1.zip (zip)

From: Sarah Wells <sarah.wells@heliohealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@heliohealth.com>, Helio Procurement <procure@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2028-09-11T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: term uplift + capacity increase — procurement portal & PO sequencing

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers from procurement and finance below (copied Ben as well):

- Portal / vendor ID: Please register under vendor code "HL-RED-21"; portal URL is https://vendor.heliohealth.com (procure@heliohealth.com).
- Billing terms: CFO asks for Net-45 for this renewal.
- Evidence: attached is our vendor questionnaire (procurement-questionnaire.pdf). Required items called out: SOC 2 Type II (latest), commercial general liability certificate, vendor attestation for PHI/PII handling, and proof of breach insurance limits.
- PO cadence: We prefer a single umbrella PO for the full term with quarterly invoices against that PO (that’s how our AP team consumes invoices).
- Signature path: Legal prefers DocuSign; procurement will ingest the signed agreement into the portal. Please include our standard signature block (we'll match signatories after we receive the DocuSign envelope).

Ben adds: can we get line-item pricing for the 36-month term with the 15% uplift and the option to ramp an additional 10% in Q3 of year 2? Also need tax id and W-9 on file.

Sending procurement-questionnaire.pdf as requested.

Sarah
Director, Procurement — Helio Health
sarah.wells@heliohealth.com

Attachment: procurement-questionnaire.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@heliohealth.com>, Sarah Wells <sarah.wells@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2028-09-12T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal: term uplift + capacity increase — procurement portal & PO sequencing

Fwding Helio's questionnaire + ask. Key items to action (please advise ETA):

1) Finance: confirm we can accept Net-45 on this account for a 36-month committed deal. If yes, what (if any) prep on invoicing required to match their umbrella-PO + quarterly invoice flow?

2) Legal/Contracts (Rishi): draft a short SOW addendum reflecting:
   - 36-month term (effective date TBD),
   - 15% committed uplift with ramp option (+10% clause in Y2 Q3),
   - Pricing schedule and invoice cadence (quarterly against umbrella PO),
   - Data handling attestation clause (we can attach the standard attestation letter).

3) Compliance/Trust (Monica): pull SOC 2 Type II extract and prepare attestation-letter.pdf. Confirm insurance cert meets Helio's listed minimums.

4) Sales Ops (Priyom): I will need the HubSpot deal updated (DL-2028-1743) with the new predicted ACV. Once legal confirms the SOW addendum draft, I'll send a DocuSign envelope and register in their vendor portal (HL-RED-21).

Attachments: procurement-questionnaire.pdf (from Helio)

If possible, can we target a first-draft SOW addendum by EOD Friday (2028-09-15)? Helio is asking to lock pricing this month so they can include the umbrella PO in October AP planning.

Thanks — Jordan

On Sep 11, 2028, Sarah Wells <sarah.wells@heliohealth.com> wrote:
> Jordan —
>
> Please find attached our procurement questionnaire. Ben and I are available this week if you want to run through any line-item clarifications.
>
> Best,

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-16T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Renewal: term uplift + capacity increase — procurement portal & PO sequencing

Quick update / decisions after internal sync:

- Finance confirms Net-45 OK for this enterprise renewal. Priyom -> will prepare billing-instruction-template.xlsx for Helio's AP and include vendor tax details (Tax ID + W-9).
- Compliance: Monica to deliver SOC 2 Type II extract and attestation-letter.pdf by EOD tomorrow (2028-09-17).
- Legal: Rishi to produce SOW-addendum-draft.docx. Key contract language: umbrella PO acceptance, quarterly invoicing, 36-month term, uplift clause with optional ramp. Rishi aims to have draft ready for internal review by 2028-09-18.
- Sales ops: Jordan to open DocuSign envelope and register vendor code HL-RED-21 in Helio portal once SOW addendum is approved. Priyom will also add hubspot link and update ACV.

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Monica: SOC2 extract + attestation-letter.pdf (owner: monica_patel) — 2028-09-17
- Rishi: SOW-addendum-draft.docx (owner: rishi_malhotra) — 2028-09-18
- Priyom: billing-instruction-template.xlsx, W-9 and vendor tax info — 2028-09-17
- Jordan: DocuSign envelope & portal registration after legal signoff — target 2028-09-19

I’ve attached the initial artifacts we’ll send to Helio once reviewed: SOW-addendum-draft.docx, billing-instruction-template.xlsx, attestation-letter.pdf. Jordan — once you get signoff, please send DocuSign and paste the envelope link in the HubSpot deal.

Thanks everyone — this sequence keeps Helio's AP on schedule for an October umbrella PO.

— Priyom
VP, Revenue Operations (on behalf of procurement coordination)
